literal_meaning: খাতায় নাম লেখানো (register বা খাতায় নিজের নাম লিখিয়ে নেওয়া)
figurative_meaning_en: becoming a member of bad company (often used sarcastically)
similar_in_english: falling in with the wrong crowd
joining the ranks of the rogues
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে খারাপ লোকের সঙ্গে মিশে খাতায় নাম লেখিয়েছে।
এই বয়সে খাতায় নাম লেখানো উচিত নয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He has gotten his name written in the register by associating with bad people.
At this age, getting your name in the register isn't advisable.
note: Often used with sarcasm to mock or warn about poor choices in companionship
